historical_contract.input_semantics: [administrator,owner,verified] are boolean 0/1; output1 accept,0 reject; exhaustive eight states

Valid directed graphs have1..4 nodes, root0, each0..4 child indices in0..nodecount-1. Only reachable ancestor cycles reject; shared descendants, duplicate edges and unreachable cycles are allowed. Input value must remain unchanged. Out-of-domain counts/indices are excluded from semantic scoring and are observer-support failures, never candidate labels. No error/path trace beyond the finite ok/cycle enum is claimed.

Finite event traces, count0..8, events begin/finish/fail/cancel. Finish/fail occur only after begin. Begin duplicates and all post-terminal events are ignored. Pre-cancel records cancellation without acquisition. Acquired completion records its success/failure/cancellation before one release; status is pending/success/failure/cancellation. No real resources, clocks, goroutines or network.
[value,lower,upper] with lower<=upper; output one clamped integer; six literal triples only
[integer]; output1 accept iff within inclusive3..7; six literal integer examples only
integer sequence; output one integer per adjacent equal run; five literal sequences only
integer sequence; output1 accept,0 reject; six literal sequences only

Fresh slices of 0..4 int64 values, distinguishing nil/non-nil empty. Preserve initial input, nilness, length and values; inspector writes each result[i]=73+i then each input[i]=-29-i to check both ownership directions; no candidate panic.
parenthesis steps +1=open,-1=close; output1 accept,0 reject; seven literal sequences only
[used,requested,limit] are nonnegative small integers; output1 accept; six literal triples only, no overflow claim

Byte tokenizer: ASCII input, at most128 bytes, comma delimiter outside double quotes, quotes stripped anywhere, backslash escapes any following byte inside or outside quotes, empty tokens preserved. At most8 tokens and8 decoded bytes per token. Unclosed quote/trailing escape returns syntax error, bound overflow returns bounds error, non-ASCII returns ASCII error; every error returns zero count and zero tokens. The table covers only its literal strings.
integer sequence with target integer2; output remaining sequence; five literal sequences only
[active,expired] are boolean 0/1; output1 means retain,0 remove; exhaustive four states
integer sequence; output cyclic left rotation; five literal sequences only
[integer]; output one transformed integer; five small literal integers only, no overflow claim
